verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֨את הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְהַקְשִׁ֣יבוּ׀ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּבֵ֤ית הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַאֲזִ֔ינוּ כִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם הַמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּֽי־ פַח֙ הֱיִיתֶ֣ם לְמִצְפָּ֔ה וְרֶ֖שֶׁת פְּרוּשָׂ֥ה עַל־ תָּבֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- zōṯ hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·haq·šî·ḇū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇêṯ ham·me·leḵ ha·’ă·zî·nū kî lā·ḵem ham·miš·pāṭ kî- p̄aḥ hĕ·yî·ṯem lə·miṣ·pāh wə·re·šeṯ pə·rū·śāh ‘al- tā·ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Hear this O priests Take heed O house of Israel Give ear O royal house For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah a net spread out on Tabor

verses.original: וְשַׁחֲטָ֥ה שֵׂטִ֖ים הֶעְמִ֑יקוּ וַאֲנִ֖י מוּסָ֥ר לְכֻלָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ša·ḥă·ṭāh śê·ṭîm he‘·mî·qū wa·’ă·nî mū·sār lə·ḵul·lām
verses.literal: The rebels are deep in slaughter but I will chastise them all

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹֽא־ נִכְחַ֣ד מִמֶּ֑נִּי כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ הִזְנֵ֣יתָ אֶפְרַ֔יִם נִטְמָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·yiś·rā·’êl lō- niḵ·ḥaḏ mim·men·nî kî ‘at·tāh hiz·nê·ṯā ’ep̄·ra·yim niṭ·mā yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I know all about Ephraim and Israel is not hidden from Me For now O Ephraim you have turned to prostitution Israel is defiled

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ מַ֣עַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם לָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־ אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ זְנוּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔ם וְאֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yit·tə·nū ma·‘al·lê·hem lā·šūḇ ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem kî rū·aḥ zə·nū·nîm bə·qir·bām wə·’eṯ- Yah·weh lō yā·ḏā·‘ū
verses.literal: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God for a spirit of prostitution is within them and they do not know the LORD

verses.original: וְעָנָ֥ה גְאֽוֹן־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּפָנָ֑יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וְאֶפְרַ֗יִם יִכָּֽשְׁלוּ֙ בַּעֲוֺנָ֔ם כָּשַׁ֥ל גַּם־ יְהוּדָ֖ה עִמָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nāh ḡə·’ō·wn- yiś·rā·’êl bə·p̄ā·nāw wə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ep̄·ra·yim yik·kā·šə·lū ba·‘ă·wō·nām kā·šal gam- yə·hū·ḏāh ‘im·mām
verses.literal: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity even Judah stumbles with them

verses.original: בְּצֹאנָ֣ם וּבִבְקָרָ֗ם יֵֽלְכ֛וּ לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָ֑אוּ חָלַ֖ץ מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣō·nām ū·ḇiḇ·qā·rām yê·lə·ḵū lə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·lō yim·ṣā·’ū ḥā·laṣ mê·hem
verses.literal: They go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD but they do not find Him He has withdrawn Himself from them

verses.original: בַּיהוָ֣ה בָּגָ֔דוּ כִּֽי־ בָנִ֥ים זָרִ֖ים יָלָ֑דוּ עַתָּ֛ה יֹאכְלֵ֥ם חֹ֖דֶשׁ אֶת־ חֶלְקֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bā·ḡā·ḏū kî- ḇā·nîm zā·rîm yā·lā·ḏū ‘at·tāh yō·ḵə·lêm ḥō·ḏeš ’eṯ- ḥel·qê·hem
verses.literal: They have been unfaithful to the LORD for they have borne illegitimate children Now the New Moon . . . will devour them along with their land

verses.original: תִּקְע֤וּ שׁוֹפָר֙ בַּגִּבְעָ֔ה חֲצֹצְרָ֖ה בָּרָמָ֑ה הָרִ֙יעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ בִּנְיָמִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: tiq·‘ū šō·w·p̄ār bag·giḇ·‘āh ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rāh bā·rā·māh hā·rî·‘ū bêṯ ’ā·wen ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā bin·yā·mîn
verses.literal: Blow the ram’s horn in Gibeah the trumpet in Ramah raise the battle cry in Beth-aven Lead on O Benjamin

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה בְּי֖וֹם תּֽוֹכֵחָ֑ה בְּשִׁבְטֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הוֹדַ֖עְתִּי נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim lə·šam·māh ṯih·yeh bə·yō·wm tō·w·ḵê·ḥāh bə·šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl hō·w·ḏa‘·tî ne·’ĕ·mā·nāh
verses.literal: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of rebuke Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain

verses.original: הָיוּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כְּמַסִּיגֵ֖י גְּב֑וּל עֲלֵיהֶ֕ם אֶשְׁפּ֥וֹךְ כַּמַּ֖יִם עֶבְרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yū śā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh kə·mas·sî·ḡê gə·ḇūl ‘ă·lê·hem ’eš·pō·wḵ kam·ma·yim ‘eḇ·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: The princes of Judah are like those who move boundary stones I will pour out My fury upon them like water

verses.original: עָשׁ֥וּק אֶפְרַ֖יִם רְצ֣וּץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֣י הוֹאִ֔יל הָלַ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵי־ צָֽו׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šūq ’ep̄·ra·yim rə·ṣūṣ miš·pāṭ kî hō·w·’îl hā·laḵ ’a·ḥă·rê- ṣāw
verses.literal: Ephraim is oppressed crushed in judgment for he is determined to follow . . . worthless idols

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֥י כָעָ֖שׁ לְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְכָרָקָ֖ב לְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ḵā·‘āš lə·’ep̄·rā·yim wə·ḵā·rā·qāḇ lə·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: So I am like a moth to Ephraim and like decay to the house of Judah

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא אֶפְרַ֜יִם אֶת־ חָלְי֗וֹ וִֽיהוּדָה֙ אֶת־ מְזֹר֔וֹ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יָרֵ֑ב וְה֗וּא לֹ֤א יוּכַל֙ לִרְפֹּ֣א לָכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ יִגְהֶ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם מָזֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ep̄·ra·yim ’eṯ- ḥā·lə·yōw wî·hū·ḏāh ’eṯ- mə·zō·rōw way·yê·leḵ ’ep̄·ra·yim ’el- ’aš·šūr way·yiš·laḥ ’el- me·leḵ yā·rêḇ wə·hū lō yū·ḵal lir·pō lā·ḵem wə·lō- yiḡ·heh mik·kem mā·zō·wr
verses.literal: When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king But he cannot . . . cure you or heal . . . your wound

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י כַשַּׁ֙חַל֙ לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם וְכַכְּפִ֖יר לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲנִ֨י אֲנִ֤י אֶטְרֹף֙ וְאֵלֵ֔ךְ אֶשָּׂ֖א וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ā·nō·ḵî ḵaš·ša·ḥal lə·’ep̄·ra·yim wə·ḵak·kə·p̄îr lə·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·nî ’ă·nî ’eṭ·rōp̄ wə·’ê·lêḵ ’eś·śā wə·’ên maṣ·ṣîl
verses.literal: For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah I even I will tear them to pieces and then go away I will carry them off where no one can rescue them

verses.original: אֵלֵ֤ךְ אָשׁ֙וּבָה֙ אֶל־ מְקוֹמִ֔י עַ֥ד אֲשֶֽׁר־ יֶאְשְׁמ֖וּ וּבִקְשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י בַּצַּ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם יְשַׁחֲרֻֽנְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·lêḵ ’ā·šū·ḇāh ’el- mə·qō·w·mî ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- ye’·šə·mū ū·ḇiq·šū p̄ā·nāy baṣ·ṣar lā·hem yə·ša·ḥă·run·nî
verses.literal: Then I will return . . . to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me . . .
